admission.justification: The renewal budget planner writes generated measurements while the record and independent current-budget checks read authored ceilings; conflating these would silently let a routine text renewal authorize a ceiling increase.

applicability: The instruction-renewal command, scripts/instruction_renewal/budgets.py, and current capsule-budget record.
conditions: Current generated measurements are stored separately from authored token-ceiling decisions in wire_budget.py.
exclusions: Developer-approved authored ceiling changes, including D822 and CAP-R03 token ceilings, are separate from generated renewal.
A whole-current-record fingerprint or individual item word budget is not required.
statement: Instruction renewal regenerates current measurements and source identities in capsule-budgets-current.json and checks compiled capsule tokens against authored COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS in wire_budget.py without changing authored ceilings; changing a ceiling remains the developer's decision.
title: Instruction renewal regenerates measurements without changing token ceilings
